summary: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of two unsecured promissory notes, each with a $50,000 principal, to sponsor Aurora Beacon LLC and SZG Limited (designee of HZJL Cayman Limited). The notes bear no interest, mature upon closing of the initial business combination, and proceeds fund a trust-account extension to May 15, 2026. Holders can convert notes into units identical to IPO units at $10.00/unit. This is a SPAC extension financing commonly used to buy time for completing a de-SPAC merger. Watch for whether the business combination closes or another extension is sought.
